latest_release.name: BitChord v1.9.1
latest_release.body:
![BitChord banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/main/Banner.png)

## Hotfix

A small hotfix release on top of v1.9.

## Changelog

- Player: a new Player theme setting (Default, Simple, Legacy), and Disable blend effects to show player icons, text and menus in plain white.
- Albums and playlists: optional full-screen cover that runs to the edges of the page.
- Content Preferences: hide Recents, videos, Top Picks for You or Find Your Mood from Home, and show music videos as square thumbnails.
- Playback: Prefer music-only version plays music videos as their audio, with the next track converted ahead so Automix and crossfade still work.
- Automix: Automix overview in the song menu shows the upcoming transition.
- Liquid Glass: Better Performance for Glass, a lighter frost for phones that struggle with the full effect.
- Addons: a quality picker for addons that offer more than one quality.
- Song matching: Direct Source Stream now checks length and artist before playing, so it no longer plays a different song or a 30-second preview.
- Bit-perfect: no more dropouts with the screen off on direct USB and AAudio exclusive, and the DAC is released during long pauses and resumes from the exact spot.
- Performance: less lag while the player slides over a page.
- UI: the search field stays readable on glass, a new earphones output icon, and refreshed loading placeholders.
- General stability fixes across the app.

## Install

**Android** (8.0 / API 26+): installs straight over v1.9 with the same signing key. Not sure which APK to take? Use the universal `BitChord-v1.9.1.apk`. The smaller ones are `arm64-v8a` (most phones), `armeabi-v7a` (old 32-bit phones) and `x86_64` (emulators, Chromebooks).

**Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV** (8.0 / API 26+): installs over v1.9 TV, or updates from inside the app. Use the universal `BitChordTV-v1.9.1.apk`, or the smaller `BitChordTV-v1.9.1_armeabi-v7a.apk`, which suits most TVs and streaming sticks (`arm64-v8a` for newer boxes like the Shield or Chromecast with Google TV).

**Wear OS** (Wear OS 3+): the watch app ships inside the phone app. Install or update it from Settings > BitChord for Wear OS.

Support Channel (Discord)
https://discord.gg/pSafNTyKZx
